description: This file defines the ContentInfoActivity class, which is an Android activity responsible for displaying detailed content information following TV UI design principles. It fetches data from an API, displays program metadata, and handles user interaction with focus and buttons.

classes.name: ContentInfoActivity
classes.description: An activity that shows detailed information about a TV content, including fetching info from an API and handling user interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets content view, sets up date/time display, action buttons, and optionally fetches content info.

methods.name: setupSystemDateTime
methods.description: Displays current system date and time in the UI.

methods.name: populateContentData
methods.description: Populates UI with static or intent-provided content data.

methods.name: fetchAndBindInfo
methods.description: Fetches detailed info for a content item from API and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: setupActionButtons
methods.description: Initializes action buttons with icons, labels, focus and click behaviors.

methods.name: animateButtonFocus
methods.description: Animates button appearance when gained or lost focus.

methods.name: handleButtonAction
methods.description: Handles actions when action buttons are pressed.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key events for navigation and selection.
